## Acceptance checklist

- [ ] The change follows the existing architecture and canonical source of truth.
- [ ] No unsupported pronunciation, IPA label, benchmark score or licence permission was invented.
- [ ] Candidate availability is not conflated with source-resolved accuracy coverage.
- [ ] Documentation and handoff reflect the actual final code state.
- [ ] No restricted corpus, audio, reviewer identity map or disallowed token-level artifact was added.
- [ ] Remaining blockers and next acceptance criteria are stated.
